summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to package purpose
details: The package advertises itself as a GraphQL config helper but its `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) runs an obfuscated setup.mjs that downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temporary directory and then invokes `bun` against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB obfuscated blob with a string-array rotator and single-letter identifiers. If a local `bun` binary is present, it is used to execute the bundle instead. The lifecycle hook fires automatically on `npm install` and runs code under an alien runtime that Node-based scanners cannot inspect. The install-time-executed payload has no relationship to the package's advertised GraphQL configuration functionality, and both the loader (setup.mjs) and the payload (math_init.js) are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style variable renaming, per-call string maps, rotated string arrays), preventing static inspection of what actually runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
